board_roster_reviewed: Board at listing (11): executive Dr. Zhang Sai (chair), Zhang Zichao, Sun Tongliang, Dou Zhiyuan - no investor link; non-executive Wang Maike (ex-chair of Yuhuan Lupu Economic Development Co., director since May 2025; no explicit link to Yuhuan Investment/Guotou stated - not counted), Lee Shen Kai (partner of Feitu Venture, GP of Feitu Xinyuan; earlier partner at Shanghai Keke PE Fund Mgmt, whose group is GP of pre-IPO investor Shanghai Qingwang) - LINKED, Song Pengfei (VP of China Broadband Capital, ultimate manager of Broadband Chengbai) - LINKED; independent NEDs Xiong Minghua (chair of Seven Seas Management VC firm, not an identified investor), Zhou Shuang, Zhao Fengmei, Wu Qingyao - no link found. Former directors (resigned before listing) not counted.
rights_and_timing: Special rights of Pre-IPO investors (including undefined 'corporate governance rights', which investors did exercise) lapse on the Listing Date; no explicit statement of a director appointment/nomination or observer right, and no 'nominated by' wording for Lee or Song. So this is a seated-seat determination based on employee/partner/representative-of-investor-GP/manager biography links, not a documented nomination right. Seats are held at listing (Lee since Jul 2015, Song since Jan 2023). Caveat: links require cross-reading biography with investor profile (name match Feitu Venture; China Broadband Capital).
